What it solves: e2e QA procedure: with the cursor bridge and front desk live, confirm the
Bubble topic exists in the forum (reused, not duplicated, across a bridge
restart); take one Let's Talk turn from Bubble and confirm both sides of the
turn appear in the Bubble topic and nothing appears in Cursor Remote; type…
